rationale: Price remains above the 9-EMA ($100.09) and is consolidating tightly within $100.04–$100.46 after tagging the day's high, with no new adverse catalyst and sentiment still positive at 0.61 — the original thesis of a continuation near the high has not been mechanically invalidated. Volume has been decelerating on the recent bars, which argues against adding aggression, but the lack of any meaningful pullback below the 9-EMA and the intact stair-step structure support staying in. A trailing stop of ~0.4% (roughly 1.3x the 5-min ATR) protects most of the open gain while leaving room to capture any final extension toward $100.50+.
